source.name: Comparator runs of openai/math with build and memory measurements

fields.replay: Per challenge: its Comparator verdict, check time and peak memory in this run.

adopted.what: Its Comparator verdict for each challenge it has finished, with the check time and peak memory
adopted.where: the Independent replay line on statement pages
